items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: Just after he got here with Randy and then we stayed in town and played with the local bands in New Orleans.

ctx.x: But not with any of the local groups up there?
Not with any local groups. Just after he got here with Randy and then we stayed in town and played with the local

bands in New Orleans. Can you tell us anything about your Uncle Morris as you remember him? Naturally we have interviewed directly with him but still if you have any other recollections of him when he was young because some things he might neglect to tell you know sometimes.
